name: qkd_static_kv_return_slots_mc_r5
slot_change_request: Official local pin grant d61fc4215; candidate only. Whole-die static boundary homes and integration remain open.

job.purpose: mc5 (Q-KVRET 10-16, rtl_change): main mc_r4 (eb93a6a22) is FUNCTIONALLY WRONG: its one-stage idle_core (current occupancy AND only the previous edge's slot) fails tb_static_return_idle_mc at both phases (+1 ck reference). r5 = mc_r4 regional resets (rs_a/rs_b/rs_c) + mc_r3c two-stage idle_core_pre/idle_hbm_pre. CLOSED mc3c (mc_r3-mc3c-b1633f90c, TT +78.98/FF +13.00) native FAIL launch 223.1 idle_core / 220.7 fault_hbm > 220. Measured on the routed mc3c db (OpenSTA, ot-pve1): every output = pin flop -> INV -> BUF/HB4/BUF out pad -> port BUF (~190 ps fixed, data pins 201-202); idle_core's flop IS at its N-face pin (40.4,212.2) but sits on a lone-sink leaf (clknet_leaf_61: 1 far u_rq flop + idle_core, leaf 71.3 ps vs 47-53) -> clock 251.4 vs 231.6 ps at the E-face pin flops (+20 ps). Fix: (1) RTL: idle_*/fault_* exports are plain pin flops (no async clear, synchronous regional clear rs_c/rs_a/hr), sticky fault state a separate internal flop, so each export Q drives only its port (single-flop anchor, no pin_reg_split copy); (2) clock topology: bounded sink clusters 16 sinks / 30 um + 20 um buffer spacing (as dscoll cesc0 ln: spread 82.3->54.5), so a lone pin-face flop gets a local leaf instead of a long return to a far cluster. Same outline/pins/grant as mc_r3/mc_r4; 0 normal-cycle delta on data; drain/fault exports clear one local edge later on reset assertion only. | mc4 (Q-KVSYS-DIE 10-16, rtl_change): native audit of the CLOSED mc3b view (mc_r3-mc3b-d4c0e5fee) FAILS capture on expected_put 259.3 ps > 190 (p_lb 248.7: idle_core compared the RAW expected_put pin) and launch actual_data 221.1 > 220. Fix: idle_core from registered captures only (slot, actual_valid; drain observation one ck edge later, never earlier, no schedule use). Same outline/pins/grant as mc_r3. | Four actual independent phase-aligned pll_hbm_data storage roots: fixed bit slices replace a single >15k storage root; no clock gating, no timing exception between same-phase roots, no normal-cycle delta. Front width259.2 removes measured66.4% utilization failure. | mc3b (Q-ELEM 10-16): mc3-9196b2eb1 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD at CTS: the only failing endpoint was idle_hbm (setup -527 / hold -90 ps): raw controller_co[0]/compiled_hbm_put pins fed the idle compare, and idle_hbm was constrained as a core_clk output. Fix: idle_hbm from registered pin captures only (+1 pll_hbm edge on the drain observation, no schedule use) and idle_hbm in the hclk output set.

reroute_reason.detail: main mc_r4 functional FAIL (tb_static_return_idle_mc both phases) + closed mc3c native launch FAIL 223.1 idle_core / 220.7 fault_hbm: r4 resets + r3c idle, plain status pin flops, bounded CTS sink clusters

hold_pad.basis: as mc3c (f97a2939c): mc3b-d4c0e5fee routed FF output hold slack with the HB2 out pad alone +9.6 ps; the 30 ps hold ECO then added 1-2 HB2 per output (TT launch 221.1). mc3c HB4 out pad: data launch <=202 ps, no ECO cells on outputs.
